name: Henderson County, TX
findings: Henderson County has 199 nonprofit organizations. 73 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 58 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Henderson County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 29 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 29 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.
